_comment: Default training configuration for the YOLOv11 wind comfort segmentation pipeline.
_comment_dataset: Points to the pre-sliced dataset (1280x1280 chips). Run dataset_converter.py first: python yoloseg_pipeline/dataset_converter.py --config yoloseg_pipeline/dataset_config.json
_comment_cache: cache=true loads all chips into RAM once at the start of training. With 1280px chips (~300-500 images) this is feasible and eliminates repeated disk I/O.
_comment_cls_pw: cls_pw=1.0 applies automatic inverse-frequency class weighting to help NEN_C and Uncomfortable which are chronically under-predicted.
name: wind_comfort_seg
